bank: EYES AND EARS -- E15 [machine judges] -- THE COVERAGE MAP
note: DRAFT MATERIAL, NEVER WIRED INTO THE GAME. Step 0 found the premise had moved and REUSE-FIRST found the pass mostly built, so what shipped is the map instead of a third judge. Every claim here carries the gate's own check string and the tool VERIFIES the string is still in the gate rather than asserting coverage.

step_zero_the_premise_moved.the_premise: DIRECTION is holding SIX claimed jobs; the art director is the bottleneck because every cook waits on a human judgement
step_zero_the_premise_moved.measured: DIRECTION holds 0 CLAIMED and 8 OPEN. the six claims cleared. the oldest unshipped claim on the whole board is LIFE + CITY.
step_zero_the_premise_moved.what_the_eight_open_rows_actually_are: five of the eight say the card is DELIVERED and the row was reopened per [one at a time]. the work is DONE and the rows wait on a thumb. no pre-judge touches that: it is a queue of finished cards waiting on one person, which is the shape EVERYTHING IS A THUMB was written to abolish, one level up.

reuse_first.consequence: E15's literal instruction would have produced a THIRD judge over the same art. REUSE-FIRST is a law, so the deliverable became the map of what is already covered.

the_coverage_map.q: Does it still READ at play size?
the_coverage_map.why: no gate shrinks art to 24 px and compares the surviving contrast

the_bigger_gap_than_either.finding: every COVERED question is covered over ONE KIND of art. a cook that is neither wardrobe nor a tile nor the target screen -- a building, a face, a prop, a vehicle -- is graded by NOTHING on this sheet.
the_bigger_gap_than_either.so: the seam DIRECTION called closed is closed for garments and tiles

the_override_meter.requirement_from_school: automation bias's named leading indicator is a DECLINING override rate, and a sustained 0% is a process failure, not proof the machine is right
the_override_meter.measured: 76 verdict records on disk; 43 mention both a machine call and a human one, IN PROSE. not one stores, per cook, the machine verdict beside the human verdict that followed.
the_override_meter.consequence: THE OVERRIDE RATE CANNOT BE COMPUTED TODAY, which means nobody would notice it going to zero. E11's disease in a third form: a number that exists only in prose is a number no machine can read.
the_override_meter.the_one_line_that_fixes_it: when a cook clears the machine pass, write its machine verdict into the same verdict record the human thumb lands in. one field, and the rate becomes a number forever after.

holds.check: no coverage claim may go stale
holds.why: a question the fleet thinks is gated and is not is worse than one nobody claims; that is exactly the rot E11 found in CLAUDE.md's own law index

holds.check: the number of E7 machine questions no gate performs has not grown
holds.why: a checker that fails on absolute badness gets muted in a week; one that fails on GROWTH survives

holds.check: the sheet still parses into 7 machine and 3 human questions
holds.why: the field names moved once already and produced a confidently empty map

deliberately_not_built: a third judge over garments and tiles (REUSE-FIRST)
a score card stapled to every cook (school: a pre-judge that annotates but still forwards everything adds work)
a queue of prepared verdicts for DIRECTION (EVERYTHING IS A THUMB)

rule_zero.trap: a coverage map that asserts instead of checking looks identical to one that works, right up until a gate is edited underneath it

controls.control: a coverage claim whose check is gone must read STALE
a coverage claim pointed at a missing gate must read NOT COVERED
the real claims must still come back COVERED, or the map is just always-false

the_instruments_one_bug.bug: I read E7's sheet with the wrong field names (by/ask instead of who/q) and the first run printed 0 machine questions and 10 human ones with every question text as None
the_instruments_one_bug.why_it_mattered: a coverage map built on that would have been confidently, completely wrong, and it would have looked tidy
the_instruments_one_bug.fix: the real keys are n/who/q/test/why, and the loader now asserts both groups came back non-empty so the same slip cannot pass silently again

blind_spots: the queue was measured off the board's own dates; a row's date is when it was claimed, not when its work stalled
the coverage map is my reading of which gate performs which test, verified only to the extent that the gate still carries the check string I credited it with
five of the seven covered questions are covered PARTIALLY: the gate performs something in the same family, not necessarily E7's exact numeric test
nothing here measures whether any cook is any good; that is the three human questions and they are correctly nobody's machine
routed: NOTHING. the gates that exist do what they say, and the two gaps are work nobody ever claimed to have done.
